## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve. What is the use case?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Does this affect the core ABI?

- [ ] Yes — this requires an RFC (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No — this is a plugin concern
- [ ] Unsure — please discuss in GitHub Discussions first
